Package com.csse3200.game.tutorial

Class BattleTutorialController

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.tutorial.BattleTutorialController
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class BattleTutorialController extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Tracks tutorial guidance without changing the rules or state of the battle it observes.
